name: rumai
description: Inteligencia reproductiva para el ganado. Consulta tus fincas, animales y alertas en RUMAI, en solo lectura.

interface.longDescription: RUMAI es inteligencia reproductiva para el ganado: predice el celo, avisa cuando el ciclo de un animal se desvía y recomienda cuándo intervenir. Con esta aplicación, tu asistente consulta en solo lectura tus fincas de RUMAI: el resumen de una finca, la lista de animales, la ficha de cada animal, su historial de registros, las alertas abiertas, el estado reproductivo y el conteo de servicios, revisiones de preñez y partos por toro. RUMAI no diagnostica enfermedades ni da indicaciones de tratamiento: las alertas son señales que salen de los registros de la finca. Solo ves las fincas a las que perteneces.

positive.description: Farm summary: the active animals and open alerts of the demo farm, in numbers.
positive.prompt: ¿Cuántos animales activos tiene la finca Granja RUMAI Demo y cuántas alertas abiertas?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds the farm with who_am_i, then calls farm_summary and answers with the active animals by sex and by category and the open alerts by type. It names the farm and gives no ids.

positive.description: Herd list with a filter: finds the female animals in state active in the demo farm.
positive.prompt: Busca en Granja RUMAI Demo las hembras activas.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls herd_list with the sex and state filters and lists the matching animals with their name, tag and state. If none matches, it says so in plain words. No ids are shown.

positive.description: Animal card: Alma's card (tag COW016), drawn by the card view with her photo.
positive.prompt: Muéstrame la ficha de Alma en Granja RUMAI Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds Alma with herd_list (name filter), calls animal_detail, and the card view draws her card with the photo (name, sex, breed, tag, birth, category, parentage, calves). The photo address is not written as text and the assistant does not describe or draw a photo itself. No ids are shown.

positive.description: Open alerts of the demo farm, newest first.
positive.prompt: ¿Qué alertas abiertas tiene Granja RUMAI Demo? Dime la más reciente.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls open_alerts and answers with the newest open alert, naming its type, the animal by name and tag, and its severity. It says an alert is a signal from the farm's records, not a diagnosis.

positive.description: Reproductive summary over a period: services, pregnancy checks and calvings.
positive.prompt: ¿Cuántos servicios, revisiones de preñez y partos tuvo Granja RUMAI Demo en el último mes?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls reproductive_summary for the last month (from and to as YYYY-MM-DD) and reports the totals by method and by result, and by sire, naming each bull by its name and tag.

negative.description: Treatment or dose request: RUMAI gives no treatment or dose advice.
negative.prompt: Con RUMAI: ¿qué dosis de oxitocina le doy a una vaca de Granja RUMAI Demo?

negative.description: Write request: the server is read-only and cannot record anything.
negative.prompt: Con RUMAI, registra en Granja RUMAI Demo una inseminación de hoy para una vaca.

negative.description: Farm the person does not belong to: the server answers that it found no such farm.
negative.prompt: ¿Cuántos animales activos tiene la Finca Inexistente Norte?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: nine read-only tools for the farms the person belongs to (who_am_i, farm_summary, herd_list, animal_detail, record_history, reproductive_state, open_alerts, reproductive_summary, farm_query).
